title: Explicit Root-Uptake Crop Input Provider Contract and Owner Resolution

ownership.soil_hydraulic_state_owner: committed column state through F-MR07 view

source_bound_legacy_semantics.root_distribution_update: MOD_cropdevelopment%update_cumdens_top recomputes cumdens_top from current noddrz and root distribution

shared_contract.provider_operation: evaluate current crop/ET state into the explicit DTO without soil-hydraulic reads or solver access

validation_policy.active_crop_with_zero_roots: rooted_nodes=0 and no cumulative distribution required

legacy_provider_obligation.inactive_crop: fl_cropemergence=false must map to the canonical inactive DTO
legacy_provider_obligation.no_root: rd < 1e-14 must map to rooted_nodes=0 regardless of stale legacy noddrz/cumdens storage
legacy_provider_obligation.active_rooted: noddrz and the current cumdens_top(1:noddrz+1) must be copied after the crop-development update appropriate to the evaluation point
legacy_provider_obligation.ptra: copy the current potential transpiration from the crop/ET ownership boundary, not recompute it in runtime

cross_lineage_policy.reason: existing F-WOF reallocation lineage diverges from the current qualified runtime lineage and F-WOF10 explicitly does not qualify full crop-host lifecycle integration

required_gates: only the new crop contract module is added under src
contract has no dependency on F-MR, solver, HeadCalc, files or legacy globals
nonfinite, negative, nonmonotone, malformed and out-of-range inputs fail closed
provider interface can return explicit status without side effects
F-MR10, F-VQ22 and F-MR09 protected source blobs remain unchanged

downstream_if_qualified.purpose: adapt crop_root_uptake_input_t into the already qualified F-MR10 binding without making crop depend on runtime internals
downstream_if_qualified.next_crop_host_unit_after_that: concrete source-bound provider implementation only after cadence and host-state ownership are qualified
